Description de l'entreprise
At Cegeka, we believe in shaping digital together. We don't just deliver technology - we work shoulder to shoulder with our clients to design, build and run resilient digital solutions that drive impact where and when it matters most.
Our broad portfolio spans application services, business solutions, quality engineering, data & AI, digital workplaces, cyber resilience, networking & regulatory services, and hybrid cloud. With a strong focus on craftsmanship, we expertly manage legacy systems while accelerating modernization and innovation.
Cegeka has a global presence with offices across 17 countries, including the Benelux region, Germany, Austria, France, Italy, Sweden, Denmark, Greece, Romania, Moldova, the United Kingdom, Canada, Colombia, the United States, and India. With over 10,000 employees, the company achieved a consolidated revenue of EUR1.3 billion in 2024.
Cegeka operates 10 high-tech data centers and 3 Security Operations Centers (SOCs) across strategic locations in Europe and the United States - including the Benelux, Italy, Romania, and the U.S. - ensuring 24/7 performance, security, and business continuity.
Founded in 1992 by André Knaepen - who currently serves as chairman of the board - Cegeka is a family-owned company headquartered in Hasselt, Belgium.
Description de la fonction
For one of our clients in the insurance sector, we are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join a team focused on the transformation of Front-Office solutions used by brokers and partners.
In this role, you will bridge business needs and IT solutions, helping to shape high-quality digital experiences within the non-life insurance domain.
Your responsibilities
Gather, analyze and document business requirements
Translate business needs into functional and non-functional requirements
Facilitate workshops with stakeholders and subject matter experts
Model business processes and create clear, structured documentation
Collaborate closely with business representatives, UX teams, developers and offshore teams
Ensure alignment between business objectives and delivered solutions
Contribute to the successful delivery of projects within scope, budget and timeline
Work within an Agile environment and participate in related ceremonies
Your profile
Minimum 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Functional Analyst within the insurance industry
Strong knowledge of non-life insurance products and processes
Proven experience in requirements gathering, analysis and functional documentation
Experience working in Agile teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Customer-focused and comfortable engaging with multiple stakeholders
Fluent in Dutch and proficient in English
Nice to have
Experience with broker portals or Front-Office applications
Knowledge of underwriting and/or claims processes
Experience with BPMN, UML and use case modelling
Strong interest in user experience (UX) and customer journeys
